estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.noneText: Start the estimate once the inspection findings are in. Urgent findings are added as jobs straight away.
estimate.readOnly: This estimate can no longer be edited.

error.estimateClosed: This estimate can no longer be changed.

error.noDraft: The estimate has no open draft.

error.findingAlreadyExcluded: This finding is already left out.

estimate.withdrawHint: Decisions already recorded stay. Jobs still awaiting a decision lapse and cannot be worked on.
estimate.overdue: Past its expiry: it is recorded as expired at the next action.
estimate.newVersionHint: Add new work, or offer declined or lapsed jobs again. Approved work carries on.

estimate.notApprovedHint: Offering a job again adds it to the draft as a new proposal at today's prices.
